source: Lilly original 1647 Christian Astrology Wellcome b30338724

prose_groups.scope: Unnumbered sixth-house introductory source heading and five significator classes

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The sixt House ... Judgments appertaining
claims.historical_only_meaning: The original ornamental heading opens a substantive unnumbered sixth-house study, not an independent numbered chapter

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Of the Infirmities and Diseases of Bodyes
claims.historical_only_meaning: The section's medical scope is historical illness and humoral temperament rather than physical modern diagnosis

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe ascending
claims.historical_only_meaning: The Ascendant's sign is named as a first health/temperament significator

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: and his Lord
claims.historical_only_meaning: Ascendant ruler is separate from ascending sign itself

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Moon
claims.historical_only_meaning: Both luminaries are included as historical health factors, not just either one alone

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon ruleth the humours
claims.historical_only_meaning: Moon is associated with humors in Lilly's premodern theory, not modern physiology

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun the Spirit vitall
claims.historical_only_meaning: Sun is associated with alleged vital spirit in period physiology, not an observable measured vital sign

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: sixt house and Lord thereof
claims.historical_only_meaning: Both sixth house and sixth ruler are specified in an additional health source

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet or Planets in the sixt
claims.historical_only_meaning: Planets physically occupying sixth are a further distinct significator class

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: seventh house and his Lord
claims.historical_only_meaning: Seventh house and ruler are included because seventh opposes the Ascendant

prose_groups.scope: Three source criteria, majority good condition and contrary weak result

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: strong or weak

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in aspect with Fortunes or not
claims.historical_only_meaning: Benefic aspects are an additional part of criterion one

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: fixed Stars of ill influence

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: free from evill aspects of Saturn and Mars
claims.historical_only_meaning: The second criterion excludes affliction by the two malefics

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Temperament equall or unequall
claims.historical_only_meaning: The third criterion evaluates humoral balance or imbalance, an unvalidated medical category

claims.historical_only_meaning: The author alleges sturdy health under the combined favorable profile, without human evidence

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon strong and not afflicted

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: not be sickly
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly proposes fewer illnesses under these compound conditions, not a clinical finding

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: all or most Significators weak and unfortunate
claims.historical_only_meaning: The contrary alleged outcome invokes the majority weak or unfortunate, continuing onto next folio

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: many and grievous Infirmities hardly curable
claims.historical_only_meaning: The historic text alleges severe/lasting sickness, not actual disease risk or outcome

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: ascendant and Lord ... intercepted ... unfortunate

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: earthly with Melancholly

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native most negligent of his own Health
claims.historical_only_meaning: This is a speculative moral/behavior assertion and not a patient-level judgment

prose_groups.scope: Sun house placements, luminary contacts and historical health/life aphorisms

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: gives long life
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author predicts longevity without quantified ages or independent outcome data

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in sixt eighth seventh or twelfth

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: few yeers much sickness many afflictions

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Moon in ...

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: ill coloured people leane and age infirme
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly claims appearance and old-age illness/weakness from the luminary condition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Madnesse or want of Understanding

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or with South Node in first or second

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: whole life to be infirme

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Fixed Stars of nature of Saturn joyned with the Lights
claims.historical_only_meaning: Saturn-like fixed stars contacting luminaries are additionally said to produce weakness

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: makes lean and infirm people
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source attributes thinness/illness to fixed-star configurations without physiological evidence

prose_groups.scope: Mars and Saturn aspects with time-of-day, wounds, falling; multiple evidence axes

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars elevated above Saturn

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: sickly and weakling
claims.historical_only_meaning: He asserts weakness from that configuration, not a validated health trait

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in the sixt sudden casuall Diseases
claims.historical_only_meaning: A Mars-sixth conjunction is said to correlate with sudden recurrent disease, without observations

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in twelfth extreme weakenesse
claims.historical_only_meaning: Mars located in twelfth is alleged to yield extreme bodily weakness

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortune Matutine

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: if Vespertine long Diseases
claims.historical_only_meaning: Evening-status malefics are instead associated with long illnesses, a contrasting historical claim

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in ascendant wounds or scars in face

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in Mid-heaven sudden violent fals
claims.historical_only_meaning: Saturn in tenth is connected to falls and loss of status in a period anecdote

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: so cast men from their Preferment
claims.historical_only_meaning: The social-status consequence of the fall is distinct from actual physical injury

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: more testimonies of health fewer Diseases
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author proposes a count/direction rule without defining numerical weights or outcome horizon

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: major part Significators unfortunate weak or afflicted
claims.historical_only_meaning: The converse majority weak/afflicted source condition is explicitly stated

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: abundance of sicknesses
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly predicts many illnesses in the weak majority case, not an objective diagnostic measure
